title: Chapter 714 - 714 Obtaining Another Great Dao Fragment; Mu Jun!
content:
Chapter 714 - 714 Obtaining Another Great Dao Fragment; Mu Jun!

Chapter 714 - 714 Obtaining Another Great Dao Fragment; Mu Jun!

714 Obtaining Another Great Dao Fragment; Mu Jun!

Zhu Yan had not expected that Lin Fan would reject him. His face turned cold.

“Little guy, do you know who I am?” he asked in a deep voice. “I’m the palace master of Fire God Palace!”

Lin Fan said, “What does this have to do with me?”

The scorching heat wave turned into a huge mountain of flames that came crashing down on Lin Fan.

“Little brat, what did you say?” Zhu Yan said sternly.

[Ding! Zhu Yan’s hatred toward you has increased to four stars.]

Since the other party constantly hated him, he was his enemy.

Did he have to talk nicely to his enemy?

Lin Fan said, “Your mother!”

“Bastard!” Zhu Yan shouted.

The terrifying aura was like a cannonball that sent Lin Fan flying.

In the next moment…

Lin Fan, who was in the Coiling Dragon Villa, opened his eyes.

His face was filled with hatred.

Then, he looked at the system again.

[Zhu Yan. Cultivation: Unknown. The palace master of the Fire God Palace. He hates you because you have monstrous cultivation talent, rejected his wish to take you in as a disciple, and insulted him. Current hatred points: 5 stars.]

Five stars!

Good fellow!

Kill!

Lin Fan thought of Curse.

However, he did not use it immediately.

It was because if he cursed him now, Zhu Yan would easily guess that he was the one who did it.

Although Zhu Yan did not know where he was at the moment, what if he found out?

After all, he was the palace master of Fire God Palace, a powerful existence whose cultivation base was unknown.

Lin Fan would wait a few years.

…

Time flew by like water.

These few years, Lin Fan had been cultivating silently.

As Earth’s concealment array failed, more and more people in the universe came to challenge Lin Fan. Lin Chengzhen entered the Dark Universe, and Lin Fan’s enemy, Zhu Yan, appeared…

TThis made Lin Fan even more eager to raise his cultivation state.

On this day, Lin Fan suddenly realized that there were many cars and many people around the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He could not help but use his spiritual power to cover the area, wanting to know the reason.

Soon, everyone’s conversation fell into their ears.

“Did the golden light really appear here last time?”

“The satellite had already taken photos. How can it be fake? Besides, don’t you feel that this place is very special?”

“I heard that the great man from a thousand years ago, Lin Fan, also lives here… Do you think he’s the master of Earth?”

“Does that great man really exist?”

“It’s really hard to say.”

…

When Lin Fan heard this, he had a look of understanding on his face.

It seemed like… when he defeated those challengers a few years ago, some people noticed the abnormality.

Lin Fan did not take this to heart. Instead, he turned his attention to Curse.

He muttered in his heart, ‘A few years have already passed.’

[Ding! Do you wish to use 100,000 spirit stones to curse Zhu Yan?]

“Yes!”

…

On a distant planet.

In the extremely imposing Fire God Palace.

Zhu Yan, who was a thousand feet tall, frowned slightly and said, “Someone cursed me? You overestimate yourself!”

With a slight thought, the curse instantly dissipated.

…

Ten years passed in the blink of an eye.

In the past ten years, Lin Fan had obtained six Immortal Crystals, five Transcendence Golden Bodies, and two pieces of Emperor-level equipment from the system.

His cultivation had reached level-six Universe.

On this day, a crisp notification sounded in his mind again.

[Ding! Congratulations, it’s been 70 years since you’ve received the advanced system. Reward: Great Dao fragment x1, Transcendence Golden Body x1, Immortal Crystal x1.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up. “Finally, another Great Dao fragment.”

He still remembered clearly that the Great Dao fragment had the magical effect of increasing the aptitude of living beings.

With a thought, he placed the mountain-like Great Dao fragment beside the Path-Understanding Tree.

Instantly, everyone in the world—especially those in the Coiling Dragon Villa—felt extremely relaxed. They felt like fish in water in regards to their cultivation, which was increasing rapidly.

Lin Fan circulated his Ethereal Breathing Technique and took a deep breath. His cultivation speed had increased by at least three times!

Lin Fan praised, “Indeed, the Great Dao fragment is extraordinary.”

…

On the other hand.

On Earth, some people who were moving bricks at the construction site suddenly became as light as swallows. It was as if they had endless strength as they moved bricks one after another into the distance.

Some people who were fighting in the arena suddenly broke through and possessed tyrannical strength, making the battle even more exciting.

…

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed.

Lin Fan’s cultivation state had broken through once again, reaching level-seven Universe.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Huang Ling, and the others had entered the Planet Realm. They were not far from breaking through to the Star Traveller state.

Among them, Xia Bing and Xia Xue had reached level-eight Star Traveller.

On this day, everyone was cultivating hard as usual.

A spaceship flew over and stopped tens of thousands of miles away from Earth.

Then, a man in a white robe appeared in front of the spaceship. He used his eyes that were filled with golden light to scan Earth.

In his field of vision, Earth was wrapped in dense spiritual fog, and there was even countless roaring spiritual dragons.

The white-robed man was surprised. “Unbelievable.”

“No wonder this planet called Earth would have a Star Lord like Lin Fan.

“There’s such a scenery outside the planet, so what’s the interior like?”

At this point, his figure flashed, and he was ready to enter Earth.

However, he was soon blocked by an invisible wall.

It was indestructible.

The white-robed man was surprised again. A protective array? A large-scale protective magic circle that protected the entire planet? Could it be that it was also from Star Lord Lin Fan?

“Not only does he have extraordinary strength, but he also has a powerful array formation? Unbelievable!”

After a long while, he opened his mouth and said, “Lin Fan, master of Earth, I’m Mujun Qinxian, a subordinate of the master of the Spring Region. May I meet you?”

…

In truth, Lin Fan had already known about the white-robed man’s arrival the moment he arrived outside of Earth.

That was because a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Level-nine Universecultivator, Qin Xian, detected.]

[Qin Xian: Level-nine Universe cultivator. A Wood Lord under the master of the Spring Region. He’s trusted by the master of the Spring Region and has good abilities.]

Level-nine Universe!

This was definitely a powerhouse.

Lin Fan immediately used his Heavenly Eye to observe him. He found more than ten weaknesses. He had six to seven ways to instantly kill him.

Thus, he felt at ease.

He was just observing Qin Xian silently on Earth, wanting to see what he was up to.

At this moment, when Lin Fan heard Qin Xian’s voice, he did not hesitate too much. Stepping out, the surrounding space rippled like a curtain of water.

In the next moment, Lin Fan’s figure appeared in the void.

“Hello, Star Lord Lin.”
